name: cutback
description: Voice-controlled video editor for the AssemblyAI Voice Agent hackathon.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @cutback/server" "npm run dev -w @cutback/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @cutback/timeline && npm run test -w @cutback/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cutback/timeline && npm run typecheck -w @cutback/server && npm run typecheck -w @cutback/web
